🧠 DAILY SMC MARKET MAP — BTC + ETH + BNB

Fresh Binance Spot data | Daily → 4H → 1H → 15M
Reference prices: BTC ~$82,895 | ETH ~$2,497 | BNB ~$750
No setup is an entry until 15M confirmation occurs.

🔥 BTCUSDT SELL — PRIMARY SETUP
HTF READ
• Daily/4H structure is bearish after the drop from the $87K area to ~$80.4K.
• Price has rebounded into $82.9K and is approaching the $83.5K resistance / prior breakdown area.
• The 1H rebound is corrective until price reclaims and holds above resistance.

🎯 SHORT POI
Wait for $82,950–$83,500 and require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.
Targets: $82,400 → $81,600 → $80,390
Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~$83,700.

🟠 ETHUSDT SELL — CONDITIONAL
HTF READ
• Daily/4H structure remains bearish after the sharp breakdown toward $2,406.
• Price is consolidating near $2,497 beneath nearby supply.
• Avoid shorting the middle of the range; wait for a retracement and rejection.

🎯 SHORT POI
Wait for $2,498–$2,512 and require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.
Targets: $2,474 → $2,440 → $2,406
Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~$2,522.

🟡 BNBUSDT SELL — SECONDARY
HTF READ
• Daily/4H remain bearish after the fall from ~$810 toward ~$717.
• The current rebound has lifted price to ~$750, approaching resistance.
• A continuation short is conditional on rejection; do not sell into a strong 15M breakout.

🎯 SHORT POI
Wait for $751–$758 and require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.
Targets: $742 → $736 → $717
Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~$762.

⚠️ SMC VERDICT
BTC is the primary setup because its rebound is testing a clearer prior breakdown area. ETH and BNB are alternatives, but all three are conditional shorts—not market sells.
If price does not retrace into the POI and confirm, there is no trade.

Educational market analysis — not financial advice.
